text: CAT-DDO 4 is the fourth such operation in the Philippines, featuring a unique public health emergency trigger. It is part of a broader disaster risk financing strategy that includes parametric insurance, reinsurance for public assets, microinsurance, and a catastrophe bond. The credit line is renewable for up to 15 years, ensuring sustained protection and reform momentum. It also integrates capacity-building initiatives like the Ready to Rebuild program and LGU COVID-19 recovery guide.

metadata.solution_name: Fourth Disaster Risk Management Development Policy Loan with a Catastrophe-Deferred Drawdown Option (CAT-DDO 4)
